newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises 32.7 points to 790.3 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises 32.7 points to 790.3 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities which was revised on Monday, rose 32.7 points from the final session of 1996 to 790.3 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
A 5.57 percent jump in the revised investment fund index paced the gains among the 10 sectoral indices where only the banking and foods sectors posted losses.
It said Monday's results were affected by changes in the composition of the indices.
